subject: POC Observability Plan and Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability Plan and Next Steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed observability plan for the 3-week POC and the immediate next steps so we all have a single source of truth. Attaching the observability template we referenced.

High-level POC goal:
- Validate Redwood inference integration for FintechX fraud-detection use case with predictable latency and measurable observability for accuracy/regression detection.

Proposed success criteria (examples to confirm):
1) End-to-end request latency p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for standard payloads
2) Per-request trace available for 100% of sampled production-like traffic during test windows
3) Key model metrics (prompt length distribution, token counts, top-1 model confidence proxy) captured and visible on dashboard
4) No data leakage; logs and exports meet FintechX retention & encryption requirements

Observability deliverables for the POC:
- Dashboard: baseline dashboards (latency, throughput, error rates, cost per token, model quality signals) – Redwood to deliver a baseline and FintechX to validate
- Tracing: distributed traces with span-level timing (Redwood SDK integration + example traces)
- Logs: structured request/response logs, redaction for PII, export to customer S3 if required
- Metrics: host/GPU metrics, in-flight request counters, queue length, cache hit rates, per-model token breakdown

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: Marcus (dashboards), Aditya (tracing + SDK snippets), Evelyn (logs export & retention config)
- FintechX: Rajiv (engineering lead), Sarah (product lead / success criteria)

Timeline (3-week POC):
- Week 0 (this week): align success criteria, share templates, confirm access (API keys, S3, docs)
- Week 1: instrumentation + initial trace/log exports from Redwood side; light traffic tests
- Week 2: baseline dashboards and alert rules; iterative tuning
- Week 3: validation against success criteria, handoff notes and next steps for production

Ask: please confirm (1) success criteria above, (2) ownership as proposed, and (3) any constraints on log export/retention. If that looks good I’ll send a short mutual action plan and kick off the instrumentation work with Marcus/Aditya/Evelyn.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-poc-observability-template.xlsx, redwood-trace-sample.jsonl

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fintechx.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications from the FintechX product side: 

Success criteria tweaks we want to make explicit:
- Add a quality signal: False-positive rate on high-confidence alerts should be < 5% over the validation set (we'll share the evaluation set)
- Retention: Logs with request/response metadata need to be kept for 90 days; full payloads can be redacted after 24 hours unless flagged for debugging

On tracing and dashboards:
- We want spans for: request receive -> model inference start -> model inference end -> postprocessing -> outbound response. Sampling at 20% is fine for week 1; if possible we’d like to ramp to 100% for short validation windows.

Ownership: Rajiv will own the FintechX side for instrumentation and will work with your engineering contacts. 

Next steps from our side: we will provision an S3 bucket for log exports (secure, encrypted) and provide access details by Monday EOD. Rajiv — can your team confirm they can accept S3 logs and a small set of traces in the sample format Marissa attached?

—Sarah
Product Lead, FintechX

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Next Steps

Thanks — quick technical notes from engineering:

1) Log/trace format: we can accept structured JSON logs to S3. The trace sample Marissa attached looks OK; please include trace_id, parent_span_id, span_name, start_ts, duration_ms, and any model tokens/length metadata in the span attributes.

2) PII/redaction: we will only store non-PII request metadata by default. If Redwood needs to include parts of the prompt for debugging, please include a flag and send via a restricted bucket we control.

3) Volume & performance: for baseline tests we expect 50-100rps. If you plan to sample at 100% during validation windows, please advise on expected disk and S3 throughput so we can ensure the bucket policy and lifecycle are set.

4) Security/compliance: all logs must be encrypted at rest (S3 SSE) and accessible only via role-based access. Our security team will request an evidence package if we move to Dedicated.

Marcus / Aditya / Evelyn — can you confirm Redwood's expected ETA for: (a) dashboard Baseline (b) trace integration snippets (c) initial S3 export config? We aim to start instrumentation next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Engineering Lead, FintechX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fintechx.com>

Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Next Steps

Appreciate the quick replies — summarized next steps & owners below so we can lock timelines: 

Confirmed success criteria (final):
- Latency: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for target payloads
- Quality: False-positive rate < 5% on the shared validation set
- Observability: Traces with required spans for validation windows; logs retained 90 days with 24-hour redaction rule for payloads

Owners & immediate deliverables (Redwood):
- Marcus Lin: deliver baseline dashboards (latency, throughput, errors, model-quality signals) by Mon 2026-03-30
- Aditya Rao: provide SDK/tracing snippets and sample traces (redwood-trace-sample.jsonl attached) by Tue 2026-03-24
- Evelyn Hart: S3 export config + retention policy guidance and redaction checklist by Wed 2026-03-25

FintechX deliverables:
- Rajiv: confirm S3 bucket and provide access by Mon EOD (we’ll coordinate IAM roles)
- Sarah: share evaluation set and validation criteria docs by Mon EOD

Mutual action plan: I’ll send a short MAP and calendar invites for the instrumentation kickoff (Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT) and a checkpoint on dashboards (Tue 2026-03-30 11:00 PT).

If everyone agrees, we’ll treat the above as the working plan and begin work next week. Thanks again — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
